text:
rachel: heads-up — on canary I hit a repeatable semantic degradation when running book-length summarization (≈10k tokens) using the new quant pipeline q2_k-plus and tokenizer-v3. appears only when we interleave two prefill sessions that overlap by ~1024 tokens.
tony: can you share the minimal repro?
rachel: yes. run two interleaved clients with staggered prefill windows: 
```
python tools/repro_interleave.py --model redwood-magnet-13b-q2_k-plus --prefills 8192,7168 --overlap 1024 --clients 2 --max-tokens 10000
```
rachel: symptom: after ~7.2k tokens one session's next-token probs collapse for ~30 tokens, and runtime logs show a small negative kv_index delta then a rope_anchor_shift logged. trimmed logs: 
```
[2026-08-11T10:14:05Z] s=cli-1 PREFILL done base=0 len=8192 kv_idx=8192 fp=0x9b4c
[2026-08-11T10:14:06Z] s=cli-2 PREFILL done base=7168 len=7168 kv_idx=7159 fp=0x9b49
[2026-08-11T10:14:06Z] WARN kv_index_delta layer=11 delta=-9
[2026-08-11T10:14:06Z] ERROR rope_anchor_shift token_pos=7234 phase_delta=3
```
chet: q2_k-plus? how different from q2_k?
rachel: q2_k-plus includes an adjusted pack routine to reduce quant bias, slightly different scaling. float32 baseline clean. q8_0 also clean. q2_k-plus and q3_b show this in canary.
sara: could tokenizer-v3 seam be shifting token boundaries?
rachel: yes — tokenizer-v3 created a 1-token variant at the chunk edge in these inputs. when combined with overlapping remap we see the non-monotonic index.
tony: try forcing rotary bypass at runtime (runtime::rotary_disable=true) — if the collapse disappears that's a strong sign it's rotation math.
rachel: did that. bypassing rotary removes the collapse but KV index delta still shows up; rope anchor shift disappears. so rotation and remap interplay.
chet: interesting. maybe remap writes interleaved leave a small negative offset; quantized rotary then multiplies error and produces phase aliasing.
sara: can you repro deterministically with a single-threaded event loop that interleaves clients (no true concurrency)? that would remove allocator races and focus on math.
rachel: single-thread interleaved run reproduced 7/40 — not deterministic but far higher than baseline. attached traces: /staging/traces/1738880000/.
ci-bot: @rachel queued job interleave-debug-1738880000 on worker-canary-9 :white_check_mark:
tony: plan: split investigations — i) remap atomicity & allocator ordering; ii) numeric accumulation in rotary for q2_k-plus. chet can you run a high-precision emulation of the quantized rotary kernel and produce per-layer residuals vs float32?
chet: on it. quick probe I added: 
```
python -c "from runtime.inspect import rotary_residuals; print(rotary_residuals('magnet-13b-q2_k-plus', pos=7200))"
```
chet: early output shows layer9 residual norm ~1.9e-6 vs float baseline; small but multiplicative across 28 layers.
sara: also add a check when remap happens: compute a cheap CRC over token sequence after remap and compare to prefill chunk CRC — if mismatch, emit metric and optionally fallback.
tony: good. add a runtime flag runtime::remap_crc_guard=true and instrument traces.
rachel: instrumented; when guard triggered we logged both raw and remapped indices and the small timing delta between prefill completions. pattern: both prefill completions occurred within the same millisecond.
chet: that points to an allocator timing window. if two allocs interleave, an off-by-small arithmetic can flip sign. I'll try a CAS allocator patch that avoids full global lock.
sara: while chet works on CAS, I'll run a micro-experiment: use int32 accumulator for rotary multiply in q2_k-plus path to see if rounding reduces residual blow-up. if that helps, we can add targeted fallback for layers where residual > threshold.
ci-bot: job interleave-emulate-1738880000 started on worker-canary-2 :white_check_mark:
tony: also add a flaky test in CI that runs the repro script 300x with both tokenizer-v2 and tokenizer-v3 so we catch regressions.
rachel: note: perf impact of CAS allocator should be minimal if implemented per-slot, not global. but need perf test.
chet: WIP: I reproduced the residual amplification in a standalone numeric harness; switching the multiply accumulator to int32 reduced layer-scale residual by ~3x and resolved the phase alias in the harness. pushing PR with benchmark.
sara: if that holds in runtime, propose a short-term mitigation: when remap_crc_guard detects a mismatch and phase_delta≥2, force rotary fallback to float32 for affected layers, plus record metric. medium-term: CAS allocator + int32 accumulation optimization.
tony: agreed. also block q2_k-plus promotion to Dedicated until we validate mitigation.
rachel: I'll open a ticket and attach failing trace + CI test. tagging @eng-ml @eng-runtime. thanks team. will update when CAS PR lands or we have clear FP-fallback telemetry. :mag:
